email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Ecommerce Webmaster role at KitchenAid in Grimbergen. With hands-on experience managing websites, configuring ecommerce platforms, and coordinating content updates, I am eager to contribute to your digital team.

In my current roles, I manage CMS content, set up product catalogues on Shopify, and run SEO and analytics to improve site performance. I have built and maintained WordPress sites, collaborated with developers on technical fixes, and tested user flows to ensure smooth launches. My familiarity with Google Analytics, Jira-like tools, and Excel/Sheets aligns with your operational needs. I am detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable juggling multiple projects.

I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch, with a strong motivation to grow in ecommerce. I would welcome the chance to bring my technical and content skills to KitchenAid.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Ecommerce Webmaster position at KitchenAid in Grimbergen. Your emphasis on hands-on operational management, cross-team collaboration, and attention to detail resonates with my experience in digital marketing, web management, and ecommerce support.

In my freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have managed CMS content, configured product catalogues on Shopify, and collaborated with developers to resolve technical issues. I have built and maintained WordPress sites, implemented structured data, and used Google Analytics and Search Console to monitor performance. My work on e-commerce sites like proteinbox.com.tr and Shopify stores involved setting up promotions, testing user flows, and ensuring accurate content across pages. I am comfortable using Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and have experience with collaboration tools similar to Jira.

I am fluent in English and have working proficiency in Dutch, with a strong desire to further develop my language skills. I am organised, detail-oriented, and enjoy the challenge of managing multiple projects simultaneously. The opportunity to contribute to KitchenAid's ecommerce strategy and grow within an international team is highly appealing.

I am confident that my technical background, ecommerce exposure, and proactive attitude would allow me to quickly add value. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your digital team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Managed CMS content and product catalogues on Shopify and WordPress, including promotional setups and content updates.
- Collaborated with developers on technical fixes and tested user flows to ensure smooth website operations.
- Used Google Analytics, Search Console, and Excel/Sheets for tracking, reporting, and data analysis.
- Built and maintained multiple websites, implementing structured data and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
- Fluent in English with working knowledge of Dutch, and experienced in international, remote team environments.
